conceptZh: 扭蛋小怪獸衝過頭，滾過頭頂的草叢又煞車折回，輕輕一踩，草葉長成「艹」，下面的太陽變成「早」，湊成「草」。
object: a round fuzzy pocket creature, a patch of springy green grass blades and a yellow toy sun
morph: grass blades sprout into the top 艹 and a little sun settles as 早 below, forming 草
creativeAngle: 衝過頭：小怪獸衝過草地滑出畫面再折回，第二次輕輕一碰，草葉才長成「艹」，下面的小太陽落成「早」。
promptEn: Create an exactly 8-second animated comedy with a locked frontal camera, bright and fresh, no flashing. Setting: a clean solid pale-cream backdrop with a pale blue-white floor. The only on-screen text is one bold, saturated grass-green Traditional Chinese glyph 草, the grass crown 艹 on top of the 早 component, centered, uncropped, filling about 70% of frame height with margins. The lead is an original round fuzzy sky-blue pocket creature with big eyes and stubby feet that bursts out of a gachapon capsule and bounces off everything; no real people. Moment one (0.0-1.8s): the capsule rolls in from the left and pops open, and the creature shoots out like a rocket across the floor at far too much speed; the first spoken 草 lands as it skids right through a patch of green grass blades, the blades whipping flat in its wake, and slides off the right edge of the frame. Moment two (1.8-3.4s): a faint bounce-bounce sound, and the creature comes sproinging back from the right edge, overshoots the other way, rolls over and over with grass stuck all over its fur, and stops dizzy in the middle with a blade stuck on its head; the second spoken 草 lands as it flops flat. Moment three (3.4-5.0s): the creature slowly gets up, tiptoes forward and taps the ground with one gentle foot; the grass blades spring up and form two neat green tufts joined into the 艹 crown at the top, a little yellow toy sun with a sleepy face rises and settles below as 早, and the word 草莓 is spoken as a tiny red strawberry with a green hat pops out of the grass at the creature's feet and wobbles. From 5.0-8.0s the glyph 草 is completely still, unobstructed and crisp in green; the creature sits at the side, nibbling a blade like a toothpick and rocking with a happy wobble, the little strawberry giggling beside it, never touching the strokes. Narration (off-screen only, warm Taiwanese Mandarin, slow, distinct, clear tones, no erhua): the voice says exactly 「草、草、草莓」, read as ㄘㄠˇ、ㄘㄠˇ、ㄘㄠˇ ㄇㄟˊ, first utterance at about 0.6s, second at about 2.9s, the word at about 4.4s, then stop with no repeats and no extra speech. No background music. No subtitles, no vocabulary text, no watermark, no clutter.

conceptZh: 玩具戰士想拔一束長草當頭盔羽毛，浣熊花生抱著一疊綠箱子也抓住另一端，兩人拔河拉到草繩像橡皮筋一樣越拉越長，「啪」一聲鬆開，雙雙跌坐在地，彈開的草叢落成「艹」、綠箱子疊成「日」、泡棉劍插進地上成「十」，拼成「草」。
object: a long stretchy rope of woven green grass, a stack of two green toy crates, and the warrior's foam sword with a crossguard
morph: the grass rope snaps and its two torn tufts spring upright as the 艹 crown; Peanut's two green crates land stacked as the 日 box with its middle line; the foam sword somersaults and plants point-down below with its crossguard forming the 十
creativeAngle: 改用拔河模式：不是小怪獸亂衝，而是戰士與花生為了一束草僵持對拉，臉越紅、腳越滑，鬆手瞬間的彈飛同時決定三個部件的落點（草叢、箱子、劍），因果一目了然；「小草」在最後由戰士頭盔上冒出的一根小草具體演出。
promptEn:
Create an exactly 8-second animated comedy, locked frontal camera, bright and fresh, no flashing. Setting: a clean solid pale-cream backdrop with a pale blue-white floor. The only on-screen text is one bold, saturated grass-green Traditional Chinese glyph 草, the grass crown 艹 on top of the 早 component, centered, uncropped, filling about 70% of frame height with margins. Lead: an original chunky toy warrior with a stubby plastic body, a dented helmet, a floppy foam sword and a round shield, all bravado and no skill. Supporting character: Peanut, a cartoon raccoon sidekick hugging a wobbling stack of two green toy crates. No real people.

Moment one (0.0-1.6s): a tall tuft of long woven green grass stands center-floor. The warrior marches in from the left, eyes it hungrily, pats the bare top of his helmet, and yanks the grass; the first spoken 草 lands as he tugs. It stretches like a rope instead of coming loose. Peanut trots in from the right balancing his crates, salutes crisply at nothing, then grabs the other end of the grass rope.

Moment two (1.6-3.6s): tug-of-war. Both lean back further and further, feet skidding on the floor, the warrior's cheeks puffing red, Peanut's tail whipping, the grass rope stretching across the whole frame thin as a rubber band and humming. A frozen half-beat of trembling anticipation.

Moment three (3.6-5.0s): SNAP. The rope lets go in the middle; both fly backwards and land on their bottoms with a cartoon squash. The second spoken 草 lands exactly as the pieces settle: the two torn grass tufts spring upright side by side at the top as the 艹 crown; Peanut's two crates sail up and land neatly stacked beneath them as the 日 box, their seam forming its middle line; the warrior's sword somersaults and plants point-down below the box, its crossguard forming the 十. Everything turns one solid grass-green, forming 草 crisply.

Moment four (5.0-8.0s): the glyph 草 stays perfectly still and unobstructed. The warrior sits dazed at the left with a dizzy grin, and the word 小草 is spoken exactly as one tiny single blade of grass sprouts from the top of his helmet and wobbles; he looks up cross-eyed at it, delighted, and strikes a proud little pose. Peanut sits at the right, salutes the glyph, and tips over. Neither touches the strokes.

Narration (off-screen only, warm Taiwanese Mandarin, slow, distinct, clear tones, no erhua): the voice says exactly 「草、草、小草」, read as ㄘㄠˇ、ㄘㄠˇ、ㄒㄧㄠˇ ㄘㄠˇ, first utterance at about 0.7s, second at about 4.0s, the word at about 5.6s, then stop with no repeats and no extra speech. Soft rope-creak, a cartoon snap and two gentle plops are the only sound effects. No background music. No subtitles, no vocabulary text, no watermark, no clutter.
